signals.text: Howe open to Man Utd talks - Monday's gossip. Eddie Howe is open to holding talks with Manchester United if they part ways with manager Michael Carrick, three Premier League clubs are monitoring Bayern Munich's Lennart Karl, plus more.
Fernandes left out - Man Utd hammered, Bournemouth brilliant - how they rated. Another catastrophic day for Manchester United and a glorious one for Bournemouth - how did the players rate?

Carrick 'saddened' by Man Utd situation after Bournemouth loss. Manchester United manager Micheal Carrick reflects on a 'tough day' after his side lost 3-0 at home to Bournemouth with his future in doubt with United without a win in their last eight games.
